'''Tom Toms''' are basic enemies, found in the first chapter of every Act. They are big, slow enemies that attack all 3 tiles in the direction they are facing.

Can be summoned as a familiar through {{a|Call of the Wild}}.

== Behavior ==
* Has a movement radius of 2 in each orthogonal direction, or 1 for moving diagonally.
* Attacks with a wide melee attack that hits 1 tile in front of it, as well as the 2 diagonal tiles in the same direction, dealing {{icon|physical damage|#=6}}.
:{{RangeIndicatorWrapper|name=wide|{{RangeIndicator
|is_aoe = true
| target_mode = direction
| aoe_mode = custom
| custom_aoe = [1 -1] [1 0] [1 1]
| unit_size = 1x1
| show_unit = true
}} }}

=== Turn Order ===
* Takes it's main turn with {{stat|Speed|1}}.

=== Tips ===
* They can use their attack to knock rocks diagonally if the opportunity presents itself.

== Trivia ==
* The name "Tom Tom" seems to be derived from "{{wikipedia|Tomcat}}," which is a slang term for a sexually mature male cat that has not yet been neutered.
** Tomcat could also refer to the slang term of the same name, used to describe a man who is sexually promiscuous or a womanizer.
* They use a .5 pitch male1 [[voice]] for cats, voiced by Jon Evans of Ridiculon.
* Tom Toms are the only Cat-type enemy that is able to be spawned from {{class|Hunter}} abilities. They will be tinted green if they are spawned from any action on the cat’s side.
